title.zh: OpenAI 2026 DevDay 发布 GPT-6.1 Sol、Dots 及约25项产品更新
title.en: OpenAI's 2026 DevDay: GPT-6.1 Sol, Dots and ~25 product updates

current_state.zh: OpenAI的新Dots代理平台是一个面向工作场所的代理系统，据The Verge的上手体验，它感觉像是企业软件，同时也能处理像订餐这样的日常消费者任务。
current_state.en: OpenAI's new Dots agent platform is a workplace-oriented agent system that, per The Verge's hands-on impressions, feels like enterprise software that can also handle everyday consumer tasks like ordering food.

updates.title_zh: GPT 6.1 Sol：以五分之一的价格实现接近Astra的智能
updates.title_en: GPT 6.1 Sol: Near-Astra intelligence for a fifth of the price
updates.what_changed_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6.1 Sol，宣传其以约五分之一的成本实现接近Astra的智能，同时推出更便宜的缓存输入定价和重组后的订阅方案，包括新的每月500美元的Pro 500档位，并降低了现有每月200美元Pro方案的额度。
updates.what_changed_en: OpenAI introduced GPT-6.1 Sol, marketed as near-Astra intelligence at roughly a fifth of the cost, alongside cheaper cached input pricing and a restructured subscription lineup including a new $500/month Pro 500 tier and reduced allowances on the existing $200 Pro plan.
updates.current_state_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6.1 Sol，宣传其以约五分之一的成本实现接近Astra的智能，同时推出更便宜的缓存输入定价和重组后的订阅方案，包括新的每月500美元的Pro 500档位，并降低了现有每月200美元Pro方案的额度。

updates.title_zh: OpenAI一周就更新GPT-6 Sol，性能逼近Astra
updates.title_en: OpenAI一周就更新GPT-6 Sol，性能逼近Astra
updates.what_changed_zh: GPT-6.1 Sol 已上线 API、Codex 和 ChatGPT Work，尚未进入普通 ChatGPT 对话；具体基准测试显示性能接近 Astra；缓存输入价格从每百万 Token 0.2 美元降至 0.1 美元；该模型在 GPT-6 Sol 发布仅一周后推出。
updates.what_changed_en: GPT-6.1 Sol has rolled out to API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work, not yet in regular ChatGPT chat; specific benchmarks show near-Astra performance; cached input price halved to $0.1 per million tokens; model released just a week after GPT-6 Sol.
updates.current_state_zh: OpenAI 发布了 GPT-6.1 Sol，定位为以约五分之一成本提供接近 Astra 的智能。该模型已上线 API、Codex 和 ChatGPT Work（尚未进入普通 ChatGPT 对话），API 标准价格不变（每百万输入 Token 2 美元、输出 10 美元），缓存输入降至 0.1 美元，基准测试显示其编程和 Computer Use 性能接近 Astra。
updates.current_state_en: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol, marketed as near-Astra intelligence at roughly a fifth of the cost. It has rolled out to API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work (not yet in regular ChatGPT chat), with API standard pricing unchanged ($2 input / $10 output per million tokens) and cached input reduced to $0.1, benchmarks showing near-Astra coding and Computer Use performance.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol just a week after GPT-6 Sol, delivering near-Astra coding and Computer Use performance at unchanged API pricing (and half the cached-input cost) with rollout to API, Codex and ChatGPT Work.
updates.detailed_summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol just a week after GPT-6 Sol, delivering near-Astra coding and Computer Use performance at unchanged API pricing (and half the cached-input cost) with rollout to API, Codex and ChatGPT Work.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI 的新代理是对 Meta 的一次出击——但它能与免费产品竞争吗？
updates.title_en: OpenAI’s new agent is a shot at Meta — but can it compete with free?
updates.what_changed_zh: 在年度 DevDay 上，OpenAI 发布了 Dots，这是一款由 GPT-6 Astra 驱动的 AI 代理，定位为与 Meta 快速增长的 Muse 代理平台竞争。
updates.what_changed_en: At its annual DevDay, OpenAI announced Dots, a GPT-6 Astra-powered AI agent positioned to compete with Meta's fast-growing Muse agent platform.
updates.current_state_zh: 在年度 DevDay 上，OpenAI 发布了 Dots，这是一款由 GPT-6 Astra 驱动的 AI 代理，定位为与 Meta 快速增长的 Muse 代理平台竞争。
updates.current_state_en: At its annual DevDay, OpenAI announced Dots, a GPT-6 Astra-powered AI agent positioned to compete with Meta's fast-growing Muse agent platform.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: At its annual DevDay, OpenAI announced Dots, a GPT-6 Astra-powered AI agent positioned to compete with Meta's fast-growing Muse agent platform.
updates.detailed_summary_en: At its annual DevDay, OpenAI announced Dots, a GPT-6 Astra-powered AI agent positioned to compete with Meta's fast-growing Muse agent platform.
updates.background_zh: Meta于2026年9月8日发布Muse，将其定位为可执行长时间任务的个人AI agent，而非只做单轮问答的聊天机器人，并在Mac与移动端免费提供。OpenAI的GPT-6系列稍早问世，其中Astra于2026年9月4日公开发布。此次DevDay上推出Dots，使两个agent平台成为直接竞争对手。
updates.background_en: Meta announced Muse, its personal AI agent for long-running tasks beyond single-exchange chat, on September 8, 2026, and offers it free for Mac and mobile. OpenAI's GPT-6 family arrived shortly before, with Astra going public on September 4, 2026. The DevDay launch of Dots sets the two agent platforms up as direct competitors.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该消息与加密市场没有直接的产品关联，但头部实验室的agent发布会影响AI agent代币板块的叙事走向，这是最接近的市场暴露点。与Meta免费Muse的竞争叙事，也会波及围绕agent产品定价与分发方式的更广泛讨论，而去中心化agent项目常以这一议题作为自身定位依据。
updates.market_impact_en: There is no direct product link to crypto, but frontier-lab agent launches shape narrative flow in the AI-agent token segment, which is the nearest point of market exposure. The competitive framing against Meta's free Muse also feeds the broader debate over pricing and distribution for agent products, an argument decentralized-agent projects commonly use for positioning.

references.title: OpenAI Unveils Dots, New A.I. Agents to Rival Meta’s Muse
